verdict.rationale: Publishing entity-choice and jurisdiction guidance is a fair axis for a law firm. However, the evidence only shows a general Knowledge Repository (updates, analyses, videos) and a Corporate practice that advises on 'entry strategy'. No published guidance on choosing between Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd is documented. Advisory services and a generic content hub are adjacent to the story, not the published guidance it asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
